notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045165/2d3657897a49c3f8744f2cfb62ac872a4524bb47.png

Corruption Rework
Many players felt too punished for failing to meet the Restoration criteria within 10 days. Previously, with enemies permanently buffed, it became extremely difficult to recover. To address this, I’ve made a significant change to the mechanic.

Now, only the boss's health is affected by Corruption. This means you’ll only need to focus your defenses during boss invasions rather than dealing with a continuous increase in enemy strength.

However, Restoration is still crucial—if ignored, bosses will become extremely difficult to stop and will deal massive damage to your Stronghold.

Balancing Changes
Other than the changes for the corruption system, I have tried to make slight adjustments that will hopefully favor the player and make things a bit more balanced.

General

Removed all crossroads and loops for the path in the starting area.


Defense Buildings

Shooting Bunker Attack Rate buffed: 0.7 → 1
Ballista Attack Damage nerfed: 50 → 25
Ballista New Skill added: Critical Hit 30%
Axe Tower Lethality buffed: 4 → 5
Catapult Explosive Damage buffed: 70 → 85


Utility Buildings

Church Rarity changed: Blue Tier → Green Tier
Church Restoration Income nerfed: 4 → 3
Pyramid Rarity changed: Gold Tier → Blue Tier
Pyramid Restoration Income nerfed: 3 base + 2 per Church → 2 base + 1 per Church
Library Research Income buffed: 3 → 4


Enemies

Enemy Nerfs

Yellow Slime Move Speed: 1.28 → 1.2
Yellow Slime HP: 640 → 620
Orc HP: 1300 → 1200
Red Knight HP: 1700 → 1600
Gold Knight HP: 2300 → 2200
Big Bug HP: 4800 → 4400
Slime Boss HP: 3200 → 2800
Troll Boss HP: 8000 → 6500
Knight Boss HP: 5500 → 5000
Bug Boss HP: 13,000 → 11,000


Enemy Buffs

Slime Boss Speed: 0.8 → 1

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Music Rework
Now after the game has been out for a little while, my wonderful musician Jan-Peter Itze felt like the music could be improved. We brainstormed together and managed to make something that we are both very proud of. Hope you enjoy the changes that he made.

Bug Fixes

 Restoration accords that give restoration on specific resource acquired, now actually gives restoration from all sources and not just filling the related resource bar.
 Fixed issue where Restoration accords related to depleting a specific resource node gave restoration from the unrelated resource nodes as well.
 Tooltip for the Ramp up skill has been clarified to say Attack Rate instead of Dexterity

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you for being patient waiting for updates on the reported bugs. Thank you for enjoying the game and I hope the wait has been worth it!

Balancing Changes

 Axe Tower base damage nerfed from 40 → 25
 Added Lethality skill to Axe Tower
 Archer Tower base attack rate nerfed from 0.85 → 0.8
 Nerfed Morality skill upgrades from 4/5 → 3/4


Bug fixes

 Fixed the bug where the game occasionally crashed or froze when you got defeated
 Fixed the bug where the you got stuck in the tutorial and not being able to close the window
 Fixed the bug where skill value text for expertise skills ended up on two rows
